_format: skill-creator eval format — see https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions.

evals.prompt: We keep calling the same thing Cart, Basket and Bag in different parts of the codebase and it's causing bugs. Help us sort out our vocabulary.
assertions: Gathers raw material first (scans code/docs/conversation for candidate terms) before asking questions
Asks pointed questions in small rounds (2-3 at a time), not a wall of questions
Proposes ONE canonical term itself with a one-line reason instead of only asking which the user prefers
Demotes the losing names to synonyms or avoid in the model
Writes the confirmed result to docs/domain/model.yaml (or the project's existing model location)

evals.prompt: How good is our domain model? Score it and tell us what to fix first.
assertions: Runs scripts/health_check.py against the model rather than eyeballing a score
Presents the 0-10 scorecard with the five dimensions
Adds qualitative judgment beyond the script (definition usability, whether contexts pull their weight)
Ends with the 2-3 fixes that would raise the score most and offers to make them
Does not chase 10/10 by deleting honest open ambiguities

evals.prompt: Turn our domain model into documentation the team can read.
assertions: Runs scripts/generate_docs.py with the model path and -o docs/domain/ instead of hand-writing the docs
Surfaces any validation warnings the generator prints and offers to fix them
Does not hand-edit generated output files
